semantics.precision_scope: Exact numeric point from named community entity Q136745002, used only as a first-campus reference locator. Source precision field is 1e-8 degree and the stored decimals are retained; neither is surveyed accuracy. Not an official point, OSM feature, boundary, entrance, parcel centroid, building footprint or observed-work extent.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: No positional accuracy or coordinate reference is supplied by the community entity. Its precision parameter describes model resolution only; independent survey accuracy remains unknown.

literal_facts: Original Google announcement names its first Malaysian data center at Elmina Business Park, Selangor.
First-hand August 15 interview discusses this same first Elmina facility.
Wikidata entity Q136745002 literally names Google Data Center, Elmina Business Park and describes a Google data center in Malaysia, with one P625 coordinate.
campus_association.analyst_reconciliation: Exact distinctive facility name and Malaysia/Elmina identity bind the community entity to the first-campus status. This is a named-community locator, not a primary surveyed-coordinate claim. No country/locality centroid was generated.

distinctness_review.method: All 176 full GeoJSON geometries, names and stable keys reviewed. Shapely 2.1.2 point intersects(shape(feature.geometry)) evaluated across every feature including complete polygons and holes. Prior sources/research and v97 aliases inspected.

nearest_selected_reference.name: NEXTDC KL1 Kuala Lumpur Data Center Campus
nearest_selected_reference.method: WGS84 geodesic between candidate point and selected feature's representative point; not minimum boundary distance.

distinctness_review.preservation: Reuse existing wikidata:Q136745002 campus key. Create current-campus-build project key matching the new current-work scope. Old 2024-groundbreaking project and source stay unchanged and unselected.
distinctness_review.mutual_candidate_check: Only this Google first campus is proposed. Unnamed Elmina Business Park II facilities, cloud-region availability zones and any later buildings are not additional sites.

successor_review.finding: The August 15 executive interview explicitly describes continuing construction and forecasts operation without a fixed opening date. Bounded exact Google/Elmina completion and cancellation searches found no authoritative actual end to that reported remaining work by August 20. This is not proof of exhaustive absence.
successor_review.unselected_developer_caution: A later developer H1 release describes a completed data-center asset and lease income in a reporting period ending June 30. It is not selected or reproduced as source evidence because its explicit content-reuse restrictions remain unresolved. Do not infer the Google campus is wholly unbuilt, that shell work remains active, or that this financial wording establishes the completion of all Google's remaining work. No specific Google/contractor trade reconciliation is asserted.
successor_review.scope_guardrail: The selected status is generic current remaining campus construction from the dated first-hand interview, not core-and-shell construction, MEP completion percentage, installed capacity, operating status or a forecast becoming actual.
